ValidationRule.description: VR-QUOTE-19: The Subsidiary (DE Entity) must match the Operation Site's subsidiary. Prevents the subsidiary/currency going stale when the Operation Site is changed on the quote. Only fires when both the site and its subsidiary are set.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Subsidiary must match the Operation Site's subsidiary. The Operation Site you selected belongs to a different subsidiary than the one on this quote. Update the Subsidiary to the Operation Site's subsidiary, or change the Operation Site.
